summary: A development track record since 1998 and a WhatsApp line are strengths, but visible template code, typos and conflicting project figures appear to cost you serious buyers.

findings.problem: The project grid shows the unfilled tokens {{title}} and {{excerpt}}, and the language toggle links to #.
findings.cost: Template code on a development page looks unfinished to investors.
findings.fix: Finished project cards and a working language switch.

findings.problem: Typos appear: 'heart of diryah', 'U.G Parking Basaments' and 'Offices Residental', and the company name appears as Albasateen, Al Basateen and The Albasateen.
findings.cost: Spelling slips and changing names weaken a premium developer brand.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one consistent brand name.

findings.problem: Palms and Gardens list identical specs, Hills and Albasateen Villas show different villa counts, and Palm View shows Available beside a SAR 650 million acquisition.
findings.cost: Conflicting project data makes buyers doubt every figure.
findings.fix: One verified fact sheet per project.

findings.problem: The enquiry dropdown omits five projects, no consent text shows near the form, and the site shows no testimonials or delivery dates.
findings.cost: Buyers for the missing projects cannot enquire and proof is thin.
findings.fix: A complete enquiry form and visible proof.

redesign: Finished project pages with verified specs and delivery dates.
A complete enquiry form with every project and WhatsApp.
Proofread copy, one brand name and visible buyer proof.
